purpose: Keep manufacturing route/supplier capability upstream of released tolerances and process notes.
current_facts: C2R1 architecture requires a removable static-sealed P003↔P007 service boundary; permanent P003↔P007 welding is rejected.
P007 is controlled as one manufactured engineering item with monolithic 316L construction and integral blind end.
Selected route is deep-bore/finish thin can with supported OD finishing, integral blind-end retention, flange machining and 3-hole drilling.
Supplier/process capability evidence remains open for 0.30 mm wall ovality/runout, blind-end thickness, measurement method and first-article process capability.

EDR-032 closes the coupled short J2 axial locator stack as P007 locator depth 2.00 ±0.05 mm and P003 pilot length 1.50 ±0.05 mm, giving 0.40..0.60 mm worst-case non-bottoming clearance; first-article capability confirmation remains required.
EDR-033 closes C04 as an ISO 5458 combined-zone pattern: 3×Ø2.90 H10 THRU; TED PCD Ø26.50; TED 120°; POSITION ⌀0.15 CZ Ⓜ | A | B. Datum B remains RFS; no datum shift is claimed.

alternatives.route: Certified 316L stock -> deep-bore ID9.4 leaving integral blind end -> finish Ø14.10 H7 locator -> supported finish OD10 thin wall -> machine OD33×3 flange / OAL35 -> drill 3×Ø2.90 on PCD26.5 -> clean/passivate as required -> inspect
required_capability_evidence: 0.30 mm wall manufacturability without unacceptable ovality/collapse
fixture/support strategy during machining and inspection

alternatives.route: Legacy permanent P003↔P007 containment weld route; not applicable to active removable C2R1 architecture.
required_capability_evidence: weld/joining process qualification for 316L thin wall
alternatives.rejection_reason: Permanent P003↔P007 weld destroys required service access and conflicts with selected removable static-sealed J2.

release_rule: Route architecture is selected. Do not release process-dependent tolerances/roughness or supplier capability claims until thin-wall/blind-end capability and inspection evidence are controlled. J2 seal/fastener/leak qualification remains separate.

released_product_requirements_from_EDR_0.C11: TOTAL RUNOUT 0.02 | B on OD and ID

capability_boundary: EDR-029 defines C07/C08/C11 product requirements and EDR-032/033 define C02/C04 release semantics. First-article proof remains required for the selected monolithic route: H9/h9 and 0.02 total runout, blind-end/thin-wall capability, and confirmation that the short C02/P003 ±0.05 axial features are reproducible. Definition closure does not equal supplier/process qualification PASS.

released_product_requirements_from_EDR_0.C02_depth: 2.00 ±0.05 mm from Datum-A mating plane; P003 pilot length 1.50 ±0.05 mm; bottom clearance 0.40..0.60 mm
released_product_requirements_from_EDR_0.C04: 3× Ø2.90 H10 THRU; TED PCD Ø26.50; TED 120°; POSITION ⌀0.15 CZ Ⓜ | A | B; Datum B RFS

release_decision.interpretation: Manufacturing route is sufficiently defined for Product Definition. Physical capability/FAI remains L8 qualification.
